scenes.headline: Water cycle in motion
scenes.body: Sunlight warms surface water, causing evaporation into the air.
scenes.narration: Sunlight warms surface water, causing evaporation into the air. Cooling water vapor condenses and clouds form above the land. Precipitation falls as rain when droplets grow heavy. Water collects in rivers and flows back toward the ocean.

scenes.headline: The water cycle moves water between the surface
scenes.body: The water cycle moves water between the surface and the atmosphere.
scenes.narration: The water cycle moves water between the surface and the atmosphere. Local temperature and weather affect how quickly water evaporates and where precipitation falls.

scenes.headline: A Library Is a Place for Knowledge
scenes.body: A library helps you find books, movies, and information easily.
scenes.narration: A library collects books, movies, and resources and organizes them so you can find information easily.

scenes.headline: Libraries Use Systems to Find Items
scenes.body: Books are sorted by subject and author for easy finding.
scenes.narration: Books are sorted by subject and author using a catalog system so users can find them quickly and easily.

scenes.headline: Maria Finds a Book on Weather
scenes.body: Maria checks weather book by title and checks it out with her card.
